senses.gloss: pr. n. (b. h.) Pishon, name of a river.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 16:4">Gen. R. s. 16</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 2:11">Gen. II, 11</cite>) <he>פ̇יש̇ון שהוא מגדל פ̇ש̇תן ומימיו מהלכין בש̇ופ̇י</he> its name was Pishon, because it raises flax (on its shores), and its waters run gently; Yalk. ib. 21.
